pairs.rationale: Vanilla cream is a directly documented eclair filling. A hot association in the reverse guessing direction is honest while preserving the pastry identity; the exact pair does not require every eclair variant to contain vanilla.
Whipped cream is the familiar savarina filling and decoration. This is a defining pastry/cream association, not a generic rule mapping all desserts to cream.

scope: Exactly two source/target observations through the existing closed-pair mechanism. No graph-edge reversal, new proxy, scoring formula or session-bound change. Both target identities are new and absent from the old 228-record impact scope.
